title: You Will Come Again
author: Nurul Hoque
text:
From the parched bosom of
Kaliganga river
Came flying some grains of hot sand
I am waiting at the Beutha shore
Fluttering fragrant handkerchief of love
You will come again
Trampling the fire of Chaitra
Towards mischief of poetry holding to subtle beauty
Towards life.
Finally
You came holding the rim of silence
Wet in emotion
Shedding all belligerence at poetry
For years fathomless
Neither of us are poetry
But every life is embellished in poetry
Your advent in this world
Erases sin, hardship, filth and drought.

9. Lethe
Pritha Chakraborty

Let the Forgetting be There
Let there be forgetting
And yet the desire to remember;

Down flows the tide

Eternal amnesia
Or strife to retain
The tussle goes on
Between Eros and Thanos

Man`s desolation
And yet the craving for a warm touch

To live on
Or
To leave....
